name: – Konstantinos Arvanitis – After § 118 – Am 20
title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2025 Rule of Law report
part_text: 118a. Emphasises that the principle of conditionality should not be misused as a political tool to advance specific agendas; underlines that any application of conditionality must be based on objective criteria and transparent processes, to prevent the politicisation of EU funding;
